context: The existing test infrastructure uses Vitest (configured in vitest.config.ts). The only test file is tests/catalogue.test.ts with 2 tests. Each module is small (20-60 lines) and pure logic — ideal for unit testing. Use the same import pattern as catalogue.test.ts: `import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'`.
